figures.caption: Architecture schematic of the implemented controls. Week 9 and Week 11 are distinct studies. Auxiliary futures are training-only; coupled futures enter action refinement. The event branch changes the selected horizon, not the eight-action execution interval.

Week 9 success rates and factorial effects with frozen 95% bootstrap intervals. Clean uncertainty resamples canonical tasks, retaining all 50 states. Affected comparisons remain descriptive; one training seed, development overlap and the JEPA research-use exception limit generalization.

Formal three-arm comparison. The event-running fixed8 control matches fixed M4 binary outcomes; adaptive routing loses 32 targeted and 10 clean successes net. Paired intervals use the frozen resampling units. Clean includes zero; latency does not compensate for the failed performance gates.

Revised-task development scores and the separately evaluated SFT continuation. The report comparison uses the existing source-bootstrap interval. Point scores on development do not establish superiority; old-task scores and robot outcomes are not pooled.

Exploratory follow-ups retain their distinct controls and panels. Selected continuation counts and the incomplete adapter screen are not estimates of general benchmark performance. Fresh H8 effects use the supplementary whole-base-task bootstrap within suites; the frozen variant intervals remain in the tables.

clean-200, ordinal 0030: adaptive only success. First manifest ordinal in this paired-outcome class. Rows show adaptive, event-running fixed8 and original fixed8. Columns show each trajectory’s first query, midpoint and last recorded pre-action observation; times differ across arms. Each image pairs front and wrist cameras. Outcomes come from the audited episode record; snapshots alone do not identify failure causes.
